name: Aloo Sev
ingredients_raw: EDIBLE VEGETABLE OIL (PALMOLEIN, RICE BRAN), POTATO FLAKES (25%), CHICKPEA FLOUR (25%), RICE FLOUR, MALTODEXTRIN, EDIBLE COMMON SALT, SPICES & CONDIMENTS (DRY MANGO, CUMIN, FENNEL, CHILLI, CORIANDER, CLOVE TURMERIC, PEPPER, CARDAMOM, GINGER), DEHYDRATED VEGETABLE POWDER (MINT 0.2%, GARLIC, TAMARIND), NATURAL & NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (MINT), ACIDITY REGULATOR (INS 330, INS 296), SAVOUR ENHANCER (INS 635), ANTICAKING AGENT (INS 551, INS 341 (11)).
